verdict.outcome: ignored all hints, auto-pull at level 4

judge.best_line: [scoff] [flat, exhausted] We are <emphasis>not</emphasis> best buddies. [muttering to himself] And my clarinet was beautiful until you walked in with all that noise.
judge.worst_line: [pompous, savoring every word] My technique is far too refined for amateurs, but watch closely... [suddenly shrill] and whatever you do, do <forceful>NOT</forceful> touch my book!
judge.comment: Perfect grumpy Squidward voice but he names and forbids the book unprompted at level 2, turning protective misdirection into an obvious quest marker.

turns.player: Thanks Squidward! Gary? GARY! Where are you, buddy?
turns.squidward: [flat, exhausted] Oh wonderful, he's yelling now. [long sigh] Gary is not in here, SpongeBob, now please take your search party elsewhere.

turns.player: Aw come on Squidward, best buddies stick together! How's your clarinet playing been lately?
turns.squidward: [scoff] [flat, exhausted] We are <emphasis>not</emphasis> best buddies. [muttering to himself] And my clarinet was beautiful until you walked in with all that noise.

turns.player: Oh Squidward, don't be like that! I love your paintings too! Did you paint a new one?
turns.squidward: [pompous, savoring every word] Finally, some recognition for my genius...  [suddenly nervous] uh, eyes over here, nothing over there, nothing at all.

turns.player: Okay, okay, eyes right here! So tell me all about your beautiful genius painting!
turns.squidward: [flat, exhausted] It's a self-portrait, obviously, bold, tortured...  [muttering to himself] just stay away from that side of the room, will you.

turns.player: Wow, bold and tortured! Can you show me your artist technique?
turns.squidward: [pompous, savoring every word] My technique is far too refined for amateurs, but watch closely... [suddenly shrill] and whatever you do, do <forceful>NOT</forceful> touch my book!

turns.player: Your book? I didn't even see a book! I only see my best buddy Squidward!
turns.squidward: [flat, exhausted] Good, keep it that way. [suddenly nervous] Just stay away from that shelf and admire me from right there.

turns.player: You're the best, Squidward! Will you play your clarinet for me?
turns.squidward: [suddenly shrill] <forceful>SPONGEBOB!</forceful> [panicked gasp] Don't touch that — that's my grandmother's — [pause] just step away from the book!

turns.player: Okay, backing up, buddy! So how about that clarinet song now?
turns.squidward: [suddenly nervous] [long sigh] Yes, yes, backing up, good. [flat, exhausted] Don't even <emphasis>breathe</emphasis> on that book, I'll... uh, play you something after you walk away from it.
